text:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up — targeting Tue 10am PT for the release announcement. Need final changelog PR link, docs landing URL, benchmark screenshot, webinar reg link, and inbound lead routing. Can eng + docs lock these by EOD Mon? :calendar:

Aj (Eng): Can do. Canary opens Mon 08:00 PT, then 30m ramp, full rollout Tue 10:00 PT. Changelog PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412 (WIP) — I'll merge once docs link is ready. Bench artifacts are in internal S3; will provide CDN link Monday AM. :gear:

Sam (Docs): I'll publish the docs landing page at /release/2026-03 and add a 'What's new' section + migration notes. Expect final public URL by Mon 16:00 PT. Will also add an anchor #changelog that you can link to. :page_facing_up:

Eli (Growth): For webinar: keeping Thursday 11am PT slot tentative. Need registration URL + short blurb for email. Also want a concise benchmark soundbite (one sentence) for the landing page — don't want numbers that overpromise. :mega:

Aj (Eng): Bench highlights (preliminary): throughput 3.2x vs baseline on same HW, median token latency -28%, cost/token -22%. Raw CSV + PNG at s3://redwood-internal/bench/2026-03/release-summary.{csv,png}. I'll convert to CDN link once artifacts are approved. Please attribute 'internal workloads' in copy. :bar_chart:

Maya (Marketing): Thanks — we'll use conservative phrasing: "up to 3x throughput" and cite our benchmark doc. Need a 1-2 line quote from eng for the post. Aj, can you provide one? :speech_balloon:

Aj (Eng): Sure — "This release improves inference throughput and lowers per-token cost through kernel plumbing and smarter KV caching, reducing median latency on common prompts." OK to use. :+1:

Sam (Docs): Doc diff / PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289 — adding migration notes and sample curl snippet. After merge, docs CI will push to CDN. I'll post final public URL here once live.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Who owns inbound lead routing? We need HubSpot flow that tags leads with utm=release2026 and routes to 'inbound-launch' queue. Also want an event for webinar signups. Eli?

Eli (Growth): I'll set up HubSpot workflow and create the 'inbound-launch' queue. Need final reg URL and UTM parameters. Can someone confirm the campaign UTM? propose: utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=release_2026 . Agree? :thinking_face:

Aj (Eng): Sounds good. Also: please don't attach raw S3 links to public pages — wait for CDN-proxied assets. I will ping infra to create signed URLs after docs publish.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release/2026-03 -> canary Mon 08:00 PT, full Tue 10:00 PT. Notified: #eng-releases, #marketing. :rocket:

Maya (Marketing): OK — marketing will draft post & email using conservative bench claim and the quote. We'll hold the send until Sam confirms docs URL and Aj confirms CDN images. Target: email send Tue 10:15 PT (15 min after announcement). Everyone ok with that cadence? :eyes:

Aj (Eng): Fine. I'll merge changelog PR Mon 17:00 PT pending docs link. If anything changes I'll call it out here. :phone:

Sam (Docs): Will aim to have docs live by Mon 16:00 PT; if delayed I'll flag by 15:00 PT.

Eli (Growth): I'll create the HubSpot workflow today and set up a test webhook. Ping me once reg url is up and I'll run a test lead through. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Marketing): Great — thanks all. I'll post the draft copy later for a quick sign-off. :tada:
